name: Zero-readout separation theorem

objects.j: anti-linear or real involution on X
objects.Fix(j): fixed locus, RH critical line for j(s)=1-conjugate(s)
objects.Y: real response space with involution J_Y
objects.A_Z: zero-side anti-invariant displacement ledger sum/integral q q^*

gates: fixed-locus separation q(x)=0 iff x in Fix(j)
nonclaim if readout is invariant/trace-shadow only

statuses.fixed_ledger_separating: fixed completed ledger squeezed and readout separates fixed locus
statuses.exhaustive_ledger_separating: finite ledgers plus vanishing tail squeeze completed ledger
statuses.moving_ledger_support_only: moving finite ledgers lack tail/exhaustivity bridge
statuses.failed_separation: anti-invariant readout does not distinguish off-fixed points
statuses.failed_visibility: zero ledger does not cover claimed zeros
